about.title: About RIVATAR
about.text: Aesthetics and production are the same work. Every design decision has to look right, and also work on the day itself. RIVATAR began with one wedding at DCity: the founder's own.
about.eye_text: Concept, colour, material and light. Each event gets one visual language, from the first impression to the last detail on the table.
about.hand_text: Timelines, suppliers, logistics and the team on site. Every stage is managed, so that on the day you can be guests at your own event.
about.founder_bio:
About eight years ago I started out as an event producer at an advertising agency that provided advertising services and event production for some of Israel's largest companies. In parallel, I worked independently, producing boutique events and designing tables for luxury events.

Over the years I became the agency's lead producer, worked across the whole field of production in Israel and abroad, and built close relationships with leading suppliers. After hundreds of satisfied clients and exceptional events, I decided to follow my dream and do what I do best. That is how I founded RIVATAR.

Every event we create is personal, shaped around the character and identity of each client: a business conference, an elegant wedding or a moving bar mitzvah. Each one combines innovative design and current trends from around the world with carefully chosen cuisine that fits the atmosphere and the concept.

The RIVATAR team of producers and suppliers manages every detail with care and professionalism, so that your event matches exactly what you asked for, with the right balance between fair prices from leading suppliers and a meticulous, luxurious event. An event that takes your breath away.
